articles.title: A Siberian Snowman in Billings
articles.summary: Winds, waves, and ice near a remote town on the Chukchi Peninsula have sculpted a series of coastal inshore lagoons that resemble an icon of winter.

articles.title: ESA Member States Fund €100M Ariane 6 ASTRIS Kick Stage Evolution

European Spaceflight has learned from the European Space Agency that a contract awarded to ArianeGroup in 2021 for the development of an Ariane 6 kick stage will be adapted to cover its evolution into an orbital transfer vehicle. articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to fly Starlink mission using Falcon 9 booster flying for a 30th time
articles.summary: The Falcon 9 rocket launching the Starlink 15-13 mission will fly on a south-easterly trajectory upon leaving pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base. Liftoff is for 7:22 a.m. PST (10:22 a.m. EST / 1522 UTC).

articles.title: Digantara raises $50 million to expand from space surveillance to missile defense
articles.summary:
Digantara Industries, an Indian space situational awareness company, has raised $50 million as it expands into the United States and pursues opportunities in missile defense.
